contexts.text: This falsity, because it is worshipped, is called... the cormorant and the bittern in the pomegranates ().
The cormorant, bittern, night-owl, raven () = kinds of falsities which arise when the Divine truths which are in the Word become of none effect.
I will set it as an inheritance for the bittern ().
The cormorant and the bittern in the pomegranates () = falsities of evil in scientifics of good.
The cormorant and the bittern () = falsity of thought and of perception.
The flocks, the wild beast of the nation, the cormorant and the bittern () = affections of falsity, and the falsities themselves, interior and exterior.
